name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is one Slay the Spire 2 gameplay expansion for private testing. Enable this single mod to test inspectable Ancient relic rewards, selected relic revisions, preview tools, and A11-A20 test rules. Seedbed is a pollution-control card: it gives 8/12 Block, sets up 2/3 total spaces, can spend 1/2 spaces immediately to plant eligible draw or discard pile cards, and uses any remaining spaces to catch later pollution before it enters hand. Planting is combat-only isolation, not play, discard, or the Exhaust keyword. It does not permanently delete Curses. Temporary Status/Curses leave the fight, Blight Sprouts count as handled, and Rootblight is frozen for this fight only without improving or worsening. Each successful plant also gives Withered Husk, turning a bad draw into 3 Block later. The Mod Settings panel localizes this description by client language. Requires BaseLib.
